title: My First Game!
author: IXRayneXI
selftext: Hey everyone! I decided to give making a game a shot and poked around for a way that felt unique. I didn't find one lol but I did find a trick that I'm curious to get some thoughts on. Using Claude AI + Kling AI, I turn animations into playable characters movesets. This is my first test. I want to make a Hilarious 2D Action game called "The Academy: Abridged". Mechanicly fun, but it's mostly meant to make you laugh. Any thoughts?

comments.author: GoneSailingDev
comments.body:
Hilarious, characters stats:  
Running: 100  
Speed: 5

Is that on purpose?

replies.author: IXRayneXI
replies.body: Yes and no. I didn't set the speed but I hadn't changed it yet. It's way better now. Working on getting some fighting animations after I fine tune the movement.

replies.author: GoneSailingDev
replies.body: Fine tuning and polishing is the way to go!

comments.author: Fit_Eye_3564
comments.body: Looks good, just the character should actually travel faster and further when running

replies.author: IXRayneXI
replies.body: I fixed that, this clip if from before cause I was really excited to have the room and character moving and just wanted to share that I'm doing this.

comments.author: TOTAL_SLOP
comments.body:
there is no game yet and the character looks like hes running on a treadmill.  
post again in a couple of weeks, when you actually have something to show off.

replies.author: IXRayneXI
replies.body: This is a proof of concept to see if the idea has merit. I've better tuned it since making this clip.

comments.author: HypnotizingGames
comments.body: It's exactly how I run in my nightmares!

comments.author: Bavariasnaps
comments.body: Would recommend to do much more testing regarding the assets. Background + foreground character most match well with their artstyle. before you havent figured that out all asset creation will go to waste later.

replies.author: IXRayneXI
replies.body: I haven't really started working on art yet so the background is just a placeholder. It's only been three days that I've been at this and I've never done anything like this. I'll add your feedback to my notes! Thank you!

comments.author: muzaffer22
comments.body: That’s how I run in my dreams

comments.author: soulglider26
comments.body:
Good that you are trying to get into gamedev! There's so much to learn.

Really the first thing to think about is.. is anything here really off? does everything make sense? It may take a while to develop that sense.

The character and background don't really match IMO

Running speed doesn't match the animation

Character disappears for a couple frames when it switches to running

And also really importantly.. I don't see a game here. When prototyping I like to focus heavily on the core gameplay component as well, unless the game is very visuals heavy (like a visual novel. which I'm actually making)

Good luck

replies.author: IXRayneXI
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback, all of this is a Alpha/Prototype. I've never done anything like this before and I've only been at this for 3 days so far. I  learning a ton! And it's cool watching this character I've been writing about come to life. I'll definitely keep pushing forward, learning and getting better so one day I can do this myself!
